newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Turbodyne starts trading on EASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: Turbodyne starts trading on EASDAQ.

text.p: U.S. automotive part manufacturer Turbodyne Technologies Inc started trading on Europe's EASDAQ exchange on Wednesday, market maker Investmentbank Austria said.
Vienna-based Investmentbank Austria said it was acting as sponsor and market maker to all Turbodyne shares.
Other initial market makers for Turbodyne are Bayerische Vereinsbank, Beeson Gregory and Herzog Heine Gedulud International, Investmentbank Austria added.
Turbodyne shares are already listed on U.S. over-the-counter market NASDAQ. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
